title: How gradient concentration scales with context length: global / per-row / per-document / random keep shares for cos 0.95 and 0.9, 2k-256k, mt11 dense f1 + mt4 f7808
result: Row-level gradient sparsity does not scale like 1/T. Under the concentration table's protocol (frozen dense checkpoint, blocks 7-31 weight gradient, 16-row steps), the per-row quota share for cos 0.95 stays flat to rising from 2k to 256k on the mt11 dense f1 checkpoint (6.06% at 2k, 8.64% at 64k, 17.02% at 256k ⚠ eval_size 80): log-log slope 0.19 [0.15, 0.23], so kept tokens per row grow as about T^1.19 (124 -> 41,916). Constant token count (slope -1) is far outside the interval. Global oracle share rises faster (slope 0.47 [0.42, 0.51]: 0.64% -> 4.5%), per-document quota 0.17 [0.12, 0.21], random about flat (53-77%). Per row against its own gradient: the share of rows whose gradient is already carried by the always-kept non-body tokens (prompt, query, answer: 0 body tokens needed) falls from 74% at 2k to 5% at 256k, and among the other rows the geometric-mean share settles at 3.0-3.5% from 16k on (2.0% at 2k; row-level log-log slope -0.01 [-0.06, 0.05] over rows with k > 0, controlling for CE). The mean rises because of a tail: contradiction rises (0.7% -> 16.5% of body tokens), outlier jumps between 2k and 8k then stays at 6.8-11%, nq is the only task whose share falls (0.71% -> 0.41%; tokens ~T^0.76). The mt4 7,808 checkpoint (trained at 8k) shows the same rise from 8k to 64k (per-row 5.1% -> 9.1%), and it reproduces the published 8k table on its own rows (0.46/4.55/13.67/53.8%). Confound: answer CE also rises with length (0.034 -> 0.356) and share rises with CE. Max length: 256k rows on 1 H200 (110 GiB peak). On 8 H200s with the blocks spread over the GPUs, 524,288 tokens fits in memory (121 GiB peak per GPU) and 655,360 runs out, but the dense forward is numerically broken past ~262k tokens (CE 2-4 at 306-350k vs 0.002-0.7 at 256k; NaN from 368k, first non-finite in Gated DeltaNet), with or without YaRN, so the sweep stops at 256k.
match: probe.py / analyze.py protocol unchanged (block-7 split, blocks 7-31 weight gradient, energy ranking, TensorSketch 32768, 16-row steps of 4 tasks x 4 rows, body tokens only); fresh ctc rows seed 20261117 per length (contradiction, nq, outlier, oolong), query layout matched to each checkpoint's training (mt11: both; mt4: after); native RoPE (all rows <= 260,491 tokens)
